_comment: License-key extraction rules per software, the asset-management counterpart of cpe-table.json. Each entry: a case-insensitive 'match' regex against the installed-software display name, a human 'label', and 'rules' - one or more of: {type:'registry', path:'HKLM:\...', value:'<name>'}, {type:'file', path:'<file>', regex:'<regex with group 1 = the key>' | jsonfield:'<name>' | line:<n>}, {type:'wmi', class:'<ClassName>', property:'<Prop>', filter:'<WQL filter>'}. The script only ever uses these as a registry value / file content / CIM property - never as code. Microsoft keys come from SoftwareLicensingProduct (the 'include Microsoft keys' switch), not from here. Keep the curated set small and correct: add your own per-program rules in the panel (Software > License keys).
